Rough morning. I'm not sure what you mean by 'the box', so is that your voicemail inbox? If so, what phone do you have, iPhone or Android? Steps differ a bit. Quick version for either: open the Phone app > Voicemail, then use Edit/select to delete in bulk. Tell me the phone and I'll give exact taps.
yes voicemail. iphone. ok let me count... 23 unheard. most are vietnamese, will the transcription thing work on those

Short answer: probably not well. iPhone voicemail transcription mostly handles English, so Vietnamese messages will likely come out garbled or blank.

Steps for 23:
1. Phone > Voicemail.
2. Tap Edit (top right), tap the circles for the ones you've dealt with, then Delete.
3. For ones you want to keep, tap a message > share icon > Save to Files so they don't count against the box.
4. Deleted ones go to 'Deleted Messages' at the bottom of the list. Tap Clear All there to actually empty it.

If listening is the hurdle, play them at speaker volume and skim just the first few seconds of each.
